description: DEF CON Groups Virtuality (DCGVR) Village hosts talks and discussions on virtual reality workspaces, governance and compliance hacking, identity systems, and grassroots community organizing.

talks.title: What Is a GRC Hacker?
talks.teaser: Allen Baranov explores how the hacker mindset can be applied to Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) to improve security culture and risk assessments.

talks.title: Ghost on the Wire
talks.teaser: hoodiepony discusses digital privacy, operational security, and network footprint reduction in virtual reality and connected cyberspace.

talks.title: Hey Crypto Bro
talks.teaser: Sam Colaizzi examines cryptocurrency hype, blockchain security pitfalls, and realistic threat models for decentralized systems.

talks.title: Gender-Inclusive Health Information Systems
talks.teaser: Squiddy explores privacy and architectural considerations for designing gender-inclusive health information systems and electronic medical records.

talks.title: VR Workspaces
talks.teaser: datalocaltmp evaluates the security, productivity, and privacy implications of working within virtual reality workspaces and spatial environments.

talks.title: Bootsquad
talks.teaser: Joe Mast highlights grassroots organizing and community mentorship initiatives across DEF CON Groups.

talks.title: The Curse of the Ncurses
talks.teaser: JBO explores the quirks, historical bugs, and text user interface development challenges in ncurses.

talks.title: Taking Down Applications with Logic
talks.teaser: Abhijeet Singh examines business logic flaws and authorization bypasses in web applications that defeat traditional security scanners.

talks.title: DCGVR Village Keynote
talks.teaser: Jayson E. Street delivers the opening keynote for the DEF CON Groups Virtuality (DCGVR) Village.
